slides.label: What's released
slides.headline: Detached on *26 to 42 ft* lots. Towns in three formats.
slides.body: Rear-lane, laneway and back-to-back towns. 131 of the 179 plans are four-bedroom.

slides.label: Entry town at $711,496
slides.headline: Ontario rebate, if you qualify.
slides.body: Plus up to $35,574 federally for a first-time buyer. No first-time buyer test on the Ontario one.

slides.label: Deposits
slides.headline: *$80K* on towns. Up to *$170K* on the 42s.
slides.body: Tarion protects 10% of the price, capped at $100,000. On the larger homes, a big part of the deposit relies on the builder.

Detached on 26 to 42 ft lots, plus three town formats.
